Adding a quick technical note from infra: the provisioning service enforces a strict "single canonical supplier" binding for onboarding via the public invite link. If an incoming accept contains an email that can map to multiple saved supplier entities (for example, a legacy subsidiary record plus your new entity), we surface an ambiguity error and block the flow to avoid accidental account merges.

Workarounds:
- Manual activation token (Ben's suggestion) — lowest risk, immediate.
- Temporary config flip: we can relax the ambiguity check for this vendor for 2 hours (engineering toggle). That will allow the accept flow to complete but we must then run a follow-up dedupe+audit. I can do the toggle now if Laura/Ben approve.
- Front-end workaround: some vendors have been successful by accepting the invite in an incognito/private browser session or from a different email address that isn't associated with legacy records. That avoids the server-side mapping step that triggers the block.

I filed a ticket and linked ONB-4821 to track permanent fixes (dedupe automation + clearer UI messaging). If you want the toggle, call it out and I'll flip it and confirm when it's back to strict mode.

— Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Onboarding Runtime
